<div class="tr">
    <div class="td" style="vertical-align: middle">
        <p style="word-break: break-all">
        <span class="rowHeader">{0}</span><br />
        <span class="rowHash" id="rowHash">{1}</span>
        </p>
    </div>
    <div class="td" style="vertical-align: middle">
        <img
        title="Copy hash to clipboard"
        class="btnCopy"
        onclick="copyToClipboard(elID)"
        src="data:image/png;base64,"
        />
    </div>
</div>
